checks.check: the account provider is configured on this origin
progression-get without an account is refused (anonymous reads nothing)
progression-reconcile without an account is refused
a presented but invalid token is refused, never downgraded
an unknown progression action is a validation failure
no route reads XP, a level, an achievement, a score or a user id from the body
the progression actions are rate-limited per IP
the client bundle source never names the database function
no event property carries a name, an email, an id of a result, a challenge or an account, a token or a session

a forged XP delta, level or award list changes nothing
the arena result offers a guest the one-line career note after the score
a signed-in save earns completion (+ win where won) and Era-first, once, in the save response
saving the same result again: already_saved, XP delta 0
another device cannot claim the result, so it cannot earn from it
cross-account: Bea's progression shows none of Joseph's Clashes or XP
the owner reads their own progression: profile, achievements with progress, recent ledger, no ids; the total moved by exactly the save's delta
